title: min-btc-node
description: Built a Bitcoin node from scratch in Rust to understand how full nodes actually propagate blocks over the network — hand-rolling the wire protocol's binary serialization and concurrent peer handling instead of leaning on a library.

title: nixos-config
description: Declarative NixOS configurations and dotfiles that turn 'it works on my machine' into a versioned, rebuildable artifact — multi-host Infrastructure-as-Code for fully reproducible environments.

title: pixel-war
description: A Web3 pixel-canvas dApp where users bid on-chain to own and color pixels, claim refunds when outbid, and mint ERC-721 snapshots of the grid — demonstrating reasoning about on-chain state and smart-contract security.

title: HomeLab Infrastructure
description: A self-hosted server (Unraid + Docker) running Jellyfin, Gitea, and Pi-hole — set up hands-on to learn bare-metal provisioning and network routing.
